title: Concept: Overly broad file permissions (ruby) — review required
description: In ruby, umasks*(s*0s*)|File.umasks*(s*0s*) sets permission bits that include world access. Broad modes on code, keys, or data turn any local account into a writer or reader. The remedy is least-privilege modes via umask 022/027.
applicability: ruby code and scripts setting file modes; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Local tampering or disclosure; MEDIUM severity, HIGH for executables, keys, and configuration.
